I'm actually scared to answer because I get criticized for everything I do. :'(

Anyway you can control manipulate the forte list by equipping the weapon you don't want to lose forte on as long as that weapon is equipped it can't be removed from the list.

Every time you introduce a new weapon it takes the place of the lowest number on the list.

This is especially useful when training finesse as you keep introducing then removing the lowest attack weapon from your forte list to keep your attack the lowest it can be.

comments.body: The 30 days don't reset when you port. So, when you first reach the port where you are building your sambuks, it's possible that let's say 25 days have passed since last time you accrued interest. Then you go to build your first sambuk.
